physicalEvidence.status: Verified prior-UT-Austin learned Panda/GR1 execution; physical20 cap; current UCF hardware unknown
physicalEvidence.summary: Full September 2025 MimicDroid uses a long-context transformer with behavior cloning, human-video wrist estimates and inverse-kinematics retargeting to control actual GR1 manipulation. Ten rollouts are conducted per task; real success rates are 0.53/0.23/0.08 across seen-object, new-object and new-environment settings. These differ from the higher simulation table. Full November 2024 LEGATO, led by Seo, separately transfers a learned visuomotor policy from handheld-tool demonstrations onto a physical Panda; its broader four-robot benchmark is simulated, with a separate actual Spot demonstration. Both projects precede Seo’s UCF move. UCF apparatus, current students and access to UT Austin robots are unverified.
